limits: Canonical Pillow BC1-with-alpha/BC3 software decode; no native GPU appearance certification.
Every authored mip retains its compressed identity, dimensions and straight RGBA pixels; no resized/generated mips, gamma conversion or premultiplication.
SCB 3.2 flag-2 points, indices, face UV/material bytes, optional vertex BGRA/RGBA, bounds and pivot remain byte-exact. No normals, reflection, winding, unit scale or pivot offset is applied.
Private decode only; no public assets, runtime history, renderer or callback bindings.
